sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000178-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Lakeside Community Health 178 on September 16, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 1.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 45%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
